name: MCX_DOMAIN
meaning: DNS domain for all MC hostnames (cms/sip/idms FQDNs)
risk: High if wrong — breaks every URL the phone uses

name: MCX_IDMS_REALM
meaning: Keycloak realm name for lab users

name: MCX_IDMS_URL
meaning: Base URL where the app obtains OAuth tokens

name: MCX_CMS_ROOT
meaning: XCAP root for user profiles (CMS)

name: MCX_GMS_ROOT
meaning: XCAP root for group documents (GMS)

name: MCX_SIP_EDGE_URI
meaning: SIP URI the phone uses for REGISTER/INVITE — resolves to P-CSCF in this lab

name: MCX_CA_FILE
meaning: Lab CA path inside containers; phones need the same CA installed

name: MCX_DB_PASSWORD
meaning: Postgres password for MC directory

name: MCX_IDMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD
meaning: Keycloak admin password

name: MCX_AS_CLIENT_SECRET
meaning: OAuth client secret used by the application server

name: MCX_SIM_CLIENT_SECRET
meaning: OAuth client for SIM-based login exchange

name: MCX_PW_ALICE
meaning: Lab password for user alice

name: MCX_PW_BOB
meaning: Lab password for user bob

name: MCX_ROLE
meaning: Selects which module this container runs (admin/cms/as/media/…)
risk: High if wrong — wrong service starts

name: MCX_ADMIN_REQUIRE_AUTH
meaning: Require bearer token for Admin API (0 = open on lab net)

name: MCX_ADMIN_HOST_PORT
meaning: Host port published for Control UI

name: HPPCN_HUB_HOST_PORT
meaning: Host port published for Hub portal

name: HUB_USER
meaning: Hub portal login username

name: HUB_PASSWORD
meaning: Hub portal login password

name: HUB_UP_MCPTT
meaning: Upstream URL Hub proxies for MCPTT Control iframe

name: MCX_MEDIA_PORT_MIN
meaning: Lowest UDP port in the media pool (must match TFT/firewall)

name: MCX_MEDIA_PORT_MAX
meaning: Highest UDP port in the media pool

name: MCX_VOICE_PORT_MIN
meaning: Start of voice RTP/RTCP/floor sub-pool

name: MCX_VOICE_PORT_MAX
meaning: End of voice sub-pool

name: MCX_VIDEO_PORT_MIN
meaning: Start of video RTP/RTCP sub-pool

name: MCX_VIDEO_PORT_MAX
meaning: End of video sub-pool

name: MCX_NO_NAT_IPV4
meaning: Do not NAT UE MCPTT traffic — required for media return path

name: DOCKER_HOST_IP
meaning: Host IP advertised in Hub/Grafana browser URLs

name: ICSI_MCPTT
meaning: IMS Communication Service Identifier for MCPTT

name: CF_PSI
meaning: Controlling-function public service identity

name: PF_PSI
meaning: Participating-function public service identity

name: RTP_INACTIVITY_S
meaning: Release floor if holder sends no RTP for this many seconds

name: MCX_FD_MAX_BYTES
meaning: Max file-distribution upload size

name: sim_bind
meaning: Whether login must match a bound IMSI

name: allow_emergency_call
meaning: User may start emergency group calls

name: allow_imminent_peril_call
meaning: User may start imminent peril (distinct from emergency)

name: allow_cancel_imminent_peril
meaning: User may cancel imminent peril

name: allow_imminent_peril
meaning: Group permits imminent peril sessions

name: max_simultaneous_calls_n6
meaning: How many simultaneous receive legs the client may keep

name: multi_monitor_mode
meaning: Multi-group audio monitoring behaviour

name: implicit_affiliation
meaning: Auto-affiliate this member when profile loads (IA)
